Maker finds — the list for Monday, November 23, 2026

The hunt shows the pieces and you judge. A thin seller description is not a reason to leave a piece out: every fact is marked stated by the seller, seen in the photo, or not known. Finished work and pieces that repeat what already stands are shown too, with that note on them. The only pieces left off are the ones beyond about 60 miles, miniature or doll-size pieces, and beds.

Every piece carries a permanent number — the big number at the top of its entry. A number is given once and never used again. To rule a piece out, tell Muggy its number and your reason, in your own words — for example: “Number 37 — that one should never have reached me, and this is the reason why.” Your reason is written into the register beside that number and becomes a rule of the hunt.

14 new pieces are shown today, numbers 53 to 66, best first. The full standing list stands below them: 66 pieces in all. No seller has been contacted and nothing has been bought.
